desc: The Dawnstar rises above as a tactical and practical folder for everyday cutting tasks. Grip the ergonomic, textured handle and open the folder easily using assisted opening and a flipper. Not only is the hawkbill blade unorthodox and eye-catching, but its downward angle expertly handles boxes, rope, and many other cutting tasks. The false edge near the top of blade makes push cuts even more efficient. Finishing touches include a custom backspacer, circular sharpening choil, and weight-relieving pockets inside the handle for a lighter carry. Indeed, the Dawnstar travels easily with a reversible deep-carry pocket clip, ready to shine whenever you need it.
